# API endpoints

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run docs:api` from packages/contracts/src/api.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

This is the contract between the browser and the server. The server router validates every request and
response against these schemas, and the browser client (`apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts`) is typed from them.
Read the [feature specs](../features/README.md) for screens, states and acceptance checks.

- Errors always use `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`. See [error codes](#error-codes).
- `user` endpoints need the session cookie set by `auth.devSignIn`, and may return `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401).
- Endpoints with params, query or a body may return `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400) with `details.issues`.
- `LocalTime` / `LocalDateTime` are wall-clock times in the trip timezone; `Timestamp` is UTC.

## F0 Foundation: identity

Spec: [F0-foundation.md](../features/F0-foundation.md)

### `auth.signIn`

`POST /api/auth/sign-in` · access **public** · UI Member 1 · server Member 4

Verify email/password with Supabase Auth and issue a private application session. Credentials and provider tokens are never returned.

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
SignInInput
```

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  user: User;
}
```

**Errors** `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `FORBIDDEN` (403), `RATE_LIMITED` (429), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `auth.signUp`

`POST /api/auth/sign-up` · access **public** · UI Member 1 · server Member 4

Register with Supabase Auth. Always asks the user to check email and then sign in; never creates an application session from unconfirmed signup data.

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
SignUpInput
```

**Response** `200`

```ts
Ok
```

**Errors** `FORBIDDEN` (403), `RATE_LIMITED` (429), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `auth.devSignIn`

`POST /api/auth/dev-sign-in` · access **public** · UI Member 1 · server Member 4

Development sign-in by email only. Available only with the file adapter outside production; always disabled with Supabase.

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
DevSignInInput
```

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  user: User;
}
```

**Errors** `FORBIDDEN` (403), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `auth.signOut`

`POST /api/auth/sign-out` · access **public** · UI Member 1 · server Member 4

Clear the session cookie. Safe to call when already signed out.

**Response** `200`

```ts
Ok
```

**Errors** none

### `auth.me`

`GET /api/me` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 4

The signed-in user. 401 means show the sign-in screen.

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  user: User;
}
```

**Errors** `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401)

### `inspirations.list`

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `inspirations.create`

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/inspirations` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 3

Atomically save and queue text/link extraction. Imports have per-user burst, daily and active-job limits. Real videos support English YouTube content up to 2 minutes. Configured Google lookup supplies matches for user confirmation; without lookup, results remain unverified.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  tripId: Id;
}
```

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
CreateInspirationInput
```

**Response** `201`

```ts
{
  inspiration: Inspiration;
  job: Job;
}
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `RATE_LIMITED` (429), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `inspirations.createFromScreenshot`

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/inspirations/screenshot` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 3

Store a private screenshot up to 4 MiB and atomically queue its save. Image extraction is deferred; add text to recover. Import and private-storage quotas apply.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  tripId: Id;
}
```

**Body** (multipart/form-data)

```ts
CreateScreenshotInput
```

**Response** `201`

```ts
{
  inspiration: Inspiration;
  job: Job;
}
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413), `RATE_LIMITED` (429), `INVALID_STATE` (409), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/inspirations/:inspirationId/retry` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 3

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/inspirations/:inspirationId/details` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 3

Atomically append recovery text and queue a failed/needs_input save. Concurrent recovery cannot create duplicate active jobs; quotas apply.

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
AddDetailsInput
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `INVALID_STATE` (409), `RATE_LIMITED` (429), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/inspirations/:inspirationId/skip` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 3

Spec: [F2-places.md](../features/F2-places.md)

### `places.list`

`GET /api/trips/:tripId/places` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 3

Candidate places with evidence, including unverified LLM extractions without provider options; optionally filtered by status.

### `places.confirm`

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/places/:placeId/confirm` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 3

Confirm one provider option (picks the branch when ambiguous). Unverified extractions cannot be confirmed. Other places confirmed to the same provider place merge into this one.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  tripId: Id;
  placeId: Id;
}
```

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
ConfirmPlaceInput
```

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  place: CandidatePlace;
  mergedPlaceIds: Id[];
}
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `INVALID_STATE` (409), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `places.reject`

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/places/:placeId/reject` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 3

Exclude a candidate from planning. Its evidence is kept.

**Path params**

```ts

  tripId: Id;

}
```

**Response** `200`

### `trips.update`

`PATCH /api/trips/:tripId` · access **user** · UI Member 1 · server Member 4

Change trip details/preferences. Concurrent changes reject with STALE_TRIP; reload before retrying. Confirmed must-visits only. Changed planning inputs mark the itinerary stale.

**Path params**

```ts

  tripId: Id;
}
```

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
UpdateTripInput
```

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  trip: Trip;
}
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `STALE_TRIP` (409), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

## F4/F5 Itinerary and views

Spec: [F4-itinerary.md](../features/F4-itinerary.md)

### `itinerary.get`

`GET /api/trips/:tripId/itinerary` · access **user** · UI Member 2 · server Member 4

Current saved version, or null. stale = places, bookings, dates, timezone or preferences changed since it was made. All three views read this.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  tripId: Id;
}
```

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  itinerary: Itinerary | null;
  stale: boolean;
}
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `itinerary.generate`

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/itinerary/generate` · access **user** · UI Member 2 · server Member 4

Build a new version from confirmed places, bookings and preferences. Unknown travel is null and partially checked; infeasible parts come back as conflicts, not errors.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  tripId: Id;
}
```

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
GenerateItineraryInput
```

**Response** `201`

```ts
{
  itinerary: Itinerary;
}
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `STALE_VERSION` (409), `INVALID_STATE` (409), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `itinerary.edit`

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/itinerary/edits` · access **user** · UI Member 2 · server Member 4

Move/remove/add/replace a stop. Affected days are re-timed and re-validated. Breaking a locked booking or truncating a visit at midnight -> EDIT_REJECTED; other conflicts are saved and returned.

**Path params**

```ts
{
  tripId: Id;
}
```

**Body** (JSON)

```ts
EditItineraryInput
```

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  itinerary: Itinerary;
  saved: boolean;
}
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `INVALID_STATE` (409), `STALE_VERSION` (409), `EDIT_REJECTED` (422), `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

### `shares.list`

`POST /api/trips/:tripId/shares/:shareId/revoke` · access **user** · UI Member 2 · server Member 4

```ts
}
```

**Response** `200`

### `shared.get`

`GET /api/shared/:token` · access **public** · UI Member 2 · server Member 4

Read-only view; stale plans are withheld (stale=true, itinerary=null, places=[]), until regenerated. Limited to 120 reads per link per minute. Revocation is never undone by a view.

**Path params**

```ts

  token: string;
}
```

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  view: SharedTripView;
}
```

**Errors** `NOT_FOUND` (404), `SHARE_REVOKED` (410), `RATE_LIMITED` (429), `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)

## Jobs

Spec: [F1-import.md](../features/F1-import.md)

### `jobs.runDue`

`POST /api/internal/jobs/run-due` · access **worker** · UI none · server Member 4

Run due imports only in local file mode with fake providers. Production/Supabase imports execute in the dedicated worker; this endpoint returns FORBIDDEN there.

**Response** `200`

```ts
{
  processed: number;
  succeeded: number;
  failed: number;
}
```

**Errors** `FORBIDDEN` (403)

## Shared types

Defined in `packages/contracts/src`. Import them from `@reel/contracts`.

### `Accommodation`

```ts
type Accommodation = {
  name: string;
  location: LatLng | null;
};
```

### `AddDetailsInput`

Text the traveler adds when a save could not be read

```ts
type AddDetailsInput = {
  text: string;
};
```

### `BudgetLevel`

```ts
type BudgetLevel = "low" | "medium" | "high";
```

### `CandidatePlace`

```ts
type CandidatePlace = {
  id: Id;
  tripId: Id;
  status: PlaceStatus;
  name: string;
  evidence: Evidence[];
  options: PlaceOption[];
  selected: PlaceOption | null;
  createdAt: Timestamp;
  updatedAt: Timestamp;
};
```

### `ConfirmPlaceInput`

Which option to confirm; required even when only one option exists

```ts
type ConfirmPlaceInput = {
  providerPlaceId: string;
};
```

### `Conflict`

```ts
type Conflict = {
  code: ConflictCode;
  severity: "error" | "warning" | "info";
  date: IsoDate | null;
  stopIds: Id[];
  placeIds: Id[];
  message: string;
  suggestion: string | null;
};
```

### `ConflictCode`

```ts
type ConflictCode = "OUTSIDE_OPENING_HOURS" | "HOURS_UNKNOWN" | "TRAVEL_UNKNOWN" | "OVERLAP" | "LOCKED_RESERVATION_UNREACHABLE" | "LOCKED_RESERVATION_CHANGED" | "DAY_OVERFLOW" | "PLACE_UNSCHEDULED" | "RESERVATION_OUTSIDE_TRIP" | "VISIT_DURATION_TRUNCATED";
```

### `CreateInspirationInput`

```ts
type CreateInspirationInput = {
  sourceType: "text";
  text: string;
  note?: string;
} | {
  sourceType: "link";
  url: string;
  note?: string;
};
```

### `CreateReservationInput`

Same-day booking: end after start, both on the same date (checked by the server)

```ts
type CreateReservationInput = {
  title: string;
  placeId?: Id | null;
  start: LocalDateTime;
  end: LocalDateTime;
  locked?: boolean;
  note?: string | null;
};
```

### `CreateScreenshotInput`

multipart/form-data fields

```ts
type CreateScreenshotInput = {
  file: unknown | unknown | unknown | unknown;
  note?: string;
};
```

### `CreateTripInput`

endDate >= startDate and at most 7 days (checked by the server)

```ts
type CreateTripInput = {
  title: string;
  destination: string;
  timezone: Timezone;
  startDate: IsoDate;
  endDate: IsoDate;
};
```

### `Day`

```ts
type Day = {
  date: IsoDate;
  stops: Stop[];
};
```

### `DevSignInInput`

```ts
type DevSignInInput = {
  email: string;
  displayName?: string;
};
```

### `EditItineraryInput`

```ts
type EditItineraryInput = {
  expectedVersion: number;
  edit: ItineraryEdit;
  dryRun?: boolean;
};
```

### `Evidence`

```ts
type Evidence = {
  inspirationId: Id;
  sourceType: SourceType;
  clue: string;
  hint?: string | null;
  excerpt: string | null;
  extractedAt: Timestamp;
};
```

### `GenerateItineraryInput`

```ts
type GenerateItineraryInput = {
  expectedVersion: number | null;
};
```

### `HoursCheck`

```ts
type HoursCheck = "open" | "closed" | "unknown" | "not_applicable";
```

### `Id`

Opaque identifier, e.g. trip_3f2a...

```ts
type Id = string;
```

### `ImportFailureCode`


## Error codes

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | Params, query or body failed the schema. details.issues lists each problem. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | 401 | No valid session. Send the user to /sign-in. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | Caller may not use this operation (e.g. dev sign-in disabled, bad worker secret). |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Missing, or owned by another account. |
| `INVALID_STATE` | 409 | Valid request, but the resource is in the wrong state (e.g. retrying a ready save). |
| `STALE_VERSION` | 409 | expectedVersion is not the current itinerary version. details.currentVersion; reload then retry. |
| `STALE_TRIP` | 409 | Trip details changed during this save. Reload and review the latest values before retrying. |
| `EDIT_REJECTED` | 422 | Edit would break a locked reservation or truncate a visit at midnight. details.conflicts explains why; nothing was saved. |
| `SHARE_REVOKED` | 410 | The viewing link was revoked by the owner. |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | Upload exceeds the size limit. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Request or import quota exceeded. Observe Retry-After/details.retryAfterSeconds before trying again. |
| `INTERNAL` | 500 | Unexpected server error. Safe to retry once. |
| `CONTRACT_VIOLATION` | 500 | Server produced a response that does not match this contract. A backend bug. |
